name: ram-a-kv KV Cache
description: Provider plugin that intercepts LLM responses for KV cache lifecycle management with ram-a-kv daemon

authToken.description: Bearer token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when non-empty; required if the daemon is exposed on a non-loopback address

restoreOnSessionStart.description: Automatically restore KV cache when a session resumes from a previous one

skipRestoreReasons.description: Session end reasons that should NOT trigger KV cache restore

prefetchOnTurnStart.description: Send turn_start to prefetch KV cache before inference

requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP request timeout for ram-a-kv daemon calls (ms)
